---
title: "Randomized study on health coaching"
params:
  lang: "en"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(s2_pool, subscript(s^2L, pool))
hook(mu_A, subscript(mean(X), "A"))
hook(mu_B, subscript(mean(X), "B"))
hook(n_A, subscript(n, "A"))
hook(n_B, subscript(n, "B"))
hook(s_A, subscript(s, "A"))
hook(s_B, subscript(s, "B"))

task <- "tgroups2"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))


## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n_A <- sample(20:50, 1)
  mu_A <- round(runif(1, 0, 18), 1)
  s_A <- round(runif(1, 2, 5), 1)
  
  n_B <- n_A + sample(-10:10, 1)
  mu_B <- round(runif(1, 0, 16), 1)
  s_B <- round(runif(1, 2, 5), 1)
  
  if(n_A == n_B)
    next


  s2_pool <- ((n_A - 1) * s_A^2 + (n_B -1) * s_B^2) / (n_A + n_B - 2)
  
  tratio <- (mu_A - mu_B) / sqrt(s2_pool * (1/n_A  + 1/n_B))
    
  if(abs(tratio)<0.5 || abs(tratio)>1.5)
    next
  
  Q <- quote(search(tgroups2, tgroups(n_A, s_A, n_B, s_B),
                    .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

tab <- data.frame(
  "Therapy A" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_A), sprintf("%.1f", mu_A), sprintf("%.1f", s_A)), 
  "Therapy B" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_B), sprintf("%.1f", mu_B), sprintf("%.1f", s_B)),
  check.names = FALSE
)

row.names(tab) <- c("Sample size", "Mean Score on WHO-5", "Standard deviation")


t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$bugs, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
```


Question
========
Consider an interventional study on the effect of health coaching on general well-being in a non-clinical sample. 
Participants are randomly allocated to an active arm A (weekly appointments with a health coach) 
and a control arm B (general health tips via e-mail). 
At the end of the intervention, general wellbeing is assessed using the Well-Being Index 
(WHO-5, measured from 0 = lowest to 25 = highest wellbeing). 
The significance level is set to $\alpha=.05$ two-tailed. Consider the following data:

````{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(tab, align=c("c", "c", "l"))
````

Calculate the pooled sample variance $s^2_\mathrm{pool}$.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The pooled variance is given by. by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
